purpose: Copy/paste handoff for migrating sec10d Reg AB firm enrichment from bespoke exact lookup orchestration to canon entity stages over the canon-owned org_mentions fixture.

commands.command: canon entity run tests/fixtures/entity/regab/org_mentions/org_mentions.csv --profile regab_firm_identity --strategy tests/fixtures/entity/profiles/regab_firm_identity.yaml --registry tests/fixtures/entity/regab/sec10d_baseline_public/registry_snapshot/firms --work-dir target/entity/sec10d-regab-firms --emit summary
canon entity review export target/entity/sec10d-regab-firms/solve/solve.json --include escrow --emit csv > target/entity/sec10d-regab-firms/review.csv

regression_checklist.invariant: sec10d remains parser-first: parser-owned org_mentions.csv and org_mentions.jsonl fields are consumed unchanged, and entity solving is not moved into the parser.
Every raw parser evidence field from org_mentions input remains byte-preserved in downstream enriched rows; canon-owned enrichment may append fields only.

Snowflake-facing enrichment appends only *_org_canon_id, *_org_canonical_name, *_org_resolution_status, *_org_registry_id, *_org_registry_version, and *_org_rule_id for each firm-bearing field prefix.
Unresolved, hard-negative, platform-label, and role-conflict surfaces are emitted with explicit reviewable or review_required status, never silently merged or blanked.
Production replay after promotion uses the exact registry lookup contract; entity workbench stages may prepare, block, solve, review, and promote candidates but do not change core lookup semantics.
The migration path has no network dependency, frontier model call, runtime model download, Python runtime dependency, or unsafe Rust path.

downstream_regression_focus: REGAB-I001 org_mentions shape accepted without parser rewrite
REGAB-I002 PNC vs Midland remains distinct or reviewable
REGAB-I003 platform/category labels do not auto-resolve as firms
